content.text: Fixed. The bug was in `ledger/currency.py`: `to_cents` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Floating-point error then made `19.99 * 100` come out as `1998.9999…`, so the result was 1998 instead of 1999. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`. The full suite now passes (5 tests).
